fields.label: Describe the image you want
fields.value: Create one premium ecommerce lifestyle photo for this wireless earbuds. Keep the exact product shape, materials, color, label, and proportions unchanged. Place it in a minimal travel desk or charging station with a soft cool highlight and no visual clutter. Keep the charging case, both earbuds, fit shape, and control surface fully visible and sharp. Make the product the main focus with realistic light, believable shadows, clean composition, and room for a crop. Do not add invented readable text, claims, extra products, watermarks, retailer logos, or a plain empty background.
